name: Flowing Purity
effectTemplate: When using an Elemental Skill, All Elemental DMG Bonus will be increased by <color=#99FFFFFF>{0}</color> for 15s, and a Bond of Life worth 24% of Max HP will be granted. This effect can be triggered once every 10s. When the Bond of Life is cleared, every 1,000 HP cleared in the process will provide <color=#99FFFFFF>{1}</color> All Elemental DMG Bonus, up to a maximum of <color=#99FFFFFF>{2}</color>. This effect lasts 15s.
